profile.summary: Syserco is a company, founded in 1973, that designs, installs and services energy management systems for buildings. Its work includes HVAC upgrades, lighting retrofits and building controls for school districts, colleges, hospitals and businesses. It has offices in California and Illinois.

review.notes: Syserco's contact page lists an 'Energy Solutions' division at 215 Fourier Ave, Fremont, CA, matching the agenda's Syserco Energy Solutions, Inc. in Fremont, and its K-12 page names two Oakland USD projects (new construction and an energy performance contract) that fit the design-build facilities work. Founding year, offices, markets, phone, address and headquarters are all shown on the cited pages and the summary is neutral.
